title: 日常問候
description: 日常生活中常用的問候與寒暄用語

sentences.en: It's been such a long time since we last ran into each other, and I have to say, you look absolutely wonderful.
sentences.zh: 我們上次碰面已經好久了，我必須說，你看起來真的很棒。

sentences.en: I wasn't expecting to see you here today, but what a pleasant surprise it is to bump into you like this.
sentences.zh: 我沒想到今天會在這裡看到你，但這樣巧遇真是一個愉快的驚喜。

sentences.en: How have you been holding up lately, considering everything that's been going on in the world?
sentences.zh: 考慮到最近世界上發生的一切，你最近還好嗎？

sentences.en: I heard through the grapevine that you recently got promoted, so congratulations on that well-deserved achievement.
sentences.zh: 我聽說你最近升職了，恭喜你獲得這個當之無愧的成就。

sentences.en: To be honest, I was just thinking about you the other day, wondering how things have been going with your new job.
sentences.zh: 老實說，前幾天我正在想你，想知道你的新工作進展如何。

sentences.en: It's so good to finally put a face to the name, since I've heard so many wonderful things about you from our mutual friends.
sentences.zh: 終於能見到本人真好，因為我從我們共同的朋友那裡聽到很多關於你的好事。

sentences.en: I hope I'm not interrupting anything important, but I just wanted to stop by and say hello while I had the chance.
sentences.zh: 希望我沒有打擾到什麼重要的事，但我只是想趁機過來打個招呼。

sentences.en: You know, every time I see you, you somehow manage to look even more energetic and cheerful than the last time.
sentences.zh: 你知道嗎，每次我見到你，你總是看起來比上一次更有活力、更開朗。

sentences.en: Since we haven't caught up in what feels like ages, why don't we grab a coffee sometime this week and have a proper chat?
sentences.zh: 既然我們好像很久沒有好好聊聊了，這週找個時間一起喝杯咖啡好好敘敘舊吧？

sentences.en: I just wanted to check in on you because the last time we spoke, you mentioned you were going through a rough patch.
sentences.zh: 我只是想關心一下你，因為上次我們聊天時，你提到你正在經歷一段困難的時期。

sentences.en: As far as I can tell, you seem to be in great spirits today, which is really nice to see after everything you've been through.
sentences.zh: 就我所見，你今天看起來精神很好，在你經歷了那麼多之後，看到這樣真的很高興。

sentences.en: I don't mean to keep you if you're in a hurry, but it was really lovely running into you here at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 如果你趕時間我不想耽誤你，但在超市遇到你真的很開心。

sentences.en: My neighbor, who just moved in last month, seems like a really friendly person, so I thought I'd go over and introduce myself.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居上個月才搬來，看起來是個很友善的人，所以我想過去自我介紹一下。

sentences.en: Having not seen each other for nearly three years, we had so much to talk about that we ended up chatting for hours.
sentences.zh: 將近三年沒見，我們有太多話要說，結果聊了好幾個小時。

sentences.en: I'm glad I decided to come to this event tonight, because otherwise I would have missed the opportunity to reconnect with you.
sentences.zh: 我很高興今晚決定來參加這個活動，否則我就會錯過與你重新聯繫的機會。

sentences.en: Please give my warmest regards to your parents when you see them, as they were always so kind and welcoming to me.
sentences.zh: 見到你父母時請代我向他們問好，他們一直對我很親切、很歡迎。

sentences.en: I hope your family is doing well, especially your daughter, who must be getting so big by now if I'm not mistaken.
sentences.zh: 希望你的家人一切都好，特別是你女兒，如果我沒記錯的話，她現在一定長很大了。

sentences.en: Although we only met briefly at last year's conference, I remember our conversation quite vividly because it was so engaging.
sentences.zh: 雖然我們在去年的會議上只是短暫見面，但我對我們的對話記憶猶新，因為真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Whenever I happen to pass by this neighborhood, I always think of the wonderful times we spent together growing up here.
sentences.zh: 每當我經過這個社區，我總會想起我們在這裡一起長大的美好時光。

sentences.en: I was actually on my way to the gym when I spotted you across the street, so I figured I'd come over and say hi.
sentences.zh: 我其實正要去健身房，在街對面看到你，所以我想過來打個招呼。

sentences.en: To tell you the truth, I almost didn't recognize you at first because you've changed your hairstyle since the last time we met.
sentences.zh: 說實話，我一開始幾乎沒認出你來，因為你自從上次見面後換了髮型。

sentences.en: It really warms my heart to see that you're doing so well, especially after all the challenges you had to overcome last year.
sentences.zh: 看到你過得這麼好真的讓我很欣慰，尤其是在你去年克服了那麼多挑戰之後。

sentences.en: If you ever find yourself in my part of town, please don't hesitate to drop by for a cup of tea and a chat.
sentences.zh: 如果你有機會到我那邊，請隨時來坐坐，喝杯茶聊聊天。

sentences.en: I can't believe it's already been five years since we graduated, and yet it feels like just yesterday that we were in class together.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信我們畢業已經五年了，但感覺我們一起上課好像就在昨天。

sentences.en: Seeing you here today has completely made my day, because I was feeling a bit down before you showed up.
sentences.zh: 今天在這裡見到你完全讓我的心情好起來了，因為在你出現之前我有點低落。

sentences.en: I'm sorry I haven't been in touch more often, but between work and family obligations, it's been hard to find the time.
sentences.zh: 抱歉我沒能更常聯繫，但在工作和家庭責任之間，很難找到時間。

sentences.en: Now that we've finally reconnected, let's make sure we don't let another year go by without getting together at least once.
sentences.zh: 既然我們終於重新聯繫上了，讓我們確保不要再讓一年過去而沒有至少聚一次。

sentences.en: I noticed you were standing over here all by yourself, so I thought I'd come over and keep you company for a while.
sentences.zh: 我注意到你一個人站在這裡，所以我想過來陪你一會兒。

sentences.en: What a small world it is that we ended up living in the same city again, after all those years of being on opposite sides of the country.
sentences.zh: 世界真小，在那麼多年分處國家兩端之後，我們又住在同一個城市了。

sentences.en: Before I forget, I wanted to tell you that everyone at the office has been asking about you and sending their best wishes.
sentences.zh: 趁我還沒忘記，我想告訴你，辦公室的每個人都在問起你，並送上最好的祝福。
